description: He wears a dark desaturated teal-grey crossed-front long coat or deel with gold-toned geometric and cloud-like woven borders at the collar, crossing closure, sleeves and hem. A white underlayer appears at the throat. Layered sleeves include darker fitted fabric extending to the wrists beneath wider outer sleeves. A brown decorated sash and belt with round metal fittings secure the waist, with woven tasselled lengths hanging at one side. Brown trousers and embroidered brown mid-calf leather boots complete the outfit. Fabrics are opaque and the styling is refined everyday steppe nobility. No headgear, weapon or armor appears; exact textile fibers are uncertain.
